messages:
Rina Gomez: Heads-up: we're rolling out a condensed self-review template for the mid-year cycle focused on outcomes + development signals. Idea: 3 bullets max per competency.
People Ops Bot: New template posted: https://redwoodinference.docs/midyear-condensed-selfreview. Form fields: accomplishments (bullets), blocker notes (1 line), growth ask (1 line).
Omar Khalid: Can we make a tiny cheat-sheet for engineers with examples that map to OKR key results? e.g., 'KR: Reduce inference latency 15%' -> Self-review line: 'Led kernel-level perf tuning; reduced median latency by 9ms (6%); next: coordinate kernel upgrade to hit KR.'
Priya Sinha: Suggest keeping language quantifiable when possible. Also include 'context flag' checkbox for cross-team work.
Daniel Brooks: For managers: include 2 quick calibration notes they can paste in the manager summary: 'Exceeds expectations: consistently drove measurable impact and lifted teammates' or 'Meets expectations: delivered on core commitments with occasional follow-up needed.'
Rina Gomez: Final: condensed template + one-page cheat sheet going in the handbook. Deadline reminder: submit by Tue EOD next week.
People Ops Bot: Reminder scheduled for 48h and 24h before deadline. :bell:
